text: {"lessons":["Selling Stocks A and B after steep losses may have reduced risk, but I should base such decisions on their outlook and my plan, not the discomfort of holding losses.","Mostly doing nothing avoided frequent reactions, but I should review my holdings and concentration regularly rather than assume inaction is always prudent.","A short record of fluctuating account values cannot establish whether my approach is working; I should use consistent goals and decision rules over time."]}
